summary.text: Rick Mason is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 97, Androscoggin County, representing Lisbon.
The page lists Rick Mason as ranking member of the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Rick Mason's occupation as Business Owner.
Listed affiliations include Hunting, Fishing, 60s-70s Music, Cars, Family.
Rick Mason lives in Lisbon and has served 5 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Bills in the Second Reading (ranking member); Inland Fisheries and Wildlife (ranking member); Transportation (member).
Family details on the page: spouse Deb, 2 children, 1 grandchild.
